Mega Evolution series · ASC

Ascended Heroes

Released January 30, 2026 · 295 cards

StandardExpanded

Ascended Heroes is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Mega Evolution series, released in English on January 30, 2026. Its main set has 217 cards, plus 78 secret rares numbered beyond the set (295 in total). It includes 243 Pokémon, 50 Trainer and 2 Energy cards, and is legal in the Standard and Expanded formats.
